author: itsalreadywhen
text: Zyxel's GS1900 patch didn't close the actively exploited zero-day (CVE-2026-107441), APT29 is running iOS/Android watering-hole exploit chains via a hijacked Ukrainian analytics script, and a Debian/Ubuntu APT flaw lets MitM attackers run code.

author: shah_sheikh
text: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution: switches that received the vendor's earlier fix for an actively exploited flaw are still open.

author: ita_ipo
text: Actively exploited: WordPress Core RCE (CVE-2026-119977), CISA deadline Nov 6. Apple pointer-auth bypass (CVE-2024-27834) also just hit the KEV list. Binance confirms $6.34B theft tied to a North Korea-linked campaign.

author: CyfirmaR
text: PHP2Shell is being actively exploited. CVE-2026-109618 + CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) = unauthenticated RCE in PHP core. Updating your CMS does NOT fix it. CYFIRMA captured the attackers' 216-host target list; attribution DPRK/Lazarus-nexus, high.

author: BytesNora
text: Hackers use n-day exploits in zero-click attacks on iOS, Android devices (CVE-2025-43529, actively exploited).

author: notCVE
text: ACTIVELY EXPLOITED, added to CISA KEV 2026-11-04. CVE-2024-27834: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability. CVSS 8.8.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: LifeboatHQ
text: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV.

author: xsociety_07
text: CISA says the WordPress core flaw (CVE-2026-119977) is actively exploited and added it to KEV on 3 Nov. CVSS 8.1, affects 4.7 to 7.1.3. Update to 7.1.4.

author: Hitono_Anzen
text: Ninja Forms (500k+ sites) has an actively exploited XSS, CVE-2026-94504, in 3.15.3 and older. A malicious form entry fires when opened in wp-admin, planting a backdoor and a hidden admin. Update to 3.15.4+.

author: veenodetech
text: Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed around 1,411 flaws. Only one was already exploited: CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass.

author: eoncire
text: A hijacked cPGuard update put a backdoor on about 2,946 servers. CISA added WordPress flaw CVE-2026-119977 to its actively exploited list.

author: stretchcloud
text: 948 Linux kernel privilege escalations, found, exploited, and patched in a single automated run (OpenAI), at roughly $1,279 each. That's the new price of a working root exploit, chain and patch included.

author: Gediminas_LA
text: OpenAI's AI found 948 ways to take over a Linux machine: each bug lets a normal user become root. About $1,279 per bug. Fixes go to maintainers for review.

author: nirmalpatel_
text: Overstating AI found exploit severity: CVE-2026-109518 is a real high-severity bug in APT (found by Max Justicz), but it is not a remote exploit that lets an attacker freely compromise any system.

author: devestacion
text: AI found the PHP2Shell exploit and then four engineers still needed two months to make the patch safe.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Strands Agents Tools before 0.8.6: per AWS (CVE-2026-115415), prompt injection could get the environment tool to return env vars unmasked, including API keys. Upgrade and rotate keys.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-63655: Prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server accepts unauthenticated requests.

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76892: Prior to 4.3.1, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server calls JSON.parse ou...

author: CVEnew
text: CVE-2026-76893: Prior to 4.3.2, the HTTP mode of @tsparticles/mcp-server reuses one stateful...

author: for_N5R1
text: EchoLeak is not one bug, it is four defenses falling in a row: a mail written for a human passes the prompt injection filter, then Copilot retrieval pulls it into context.

author: Saasnext_db
text: AI browser agents with persistent profiles: indirect prompt injection can exfiltrate credentials. Auditing 2,000 live pages revealed 412 hidden DOM injection vectors.

author: aviatrixtrc
text: Supply-chain attack targeting OpenAI Codex users via a malicious GitHub configuration bundle: no executable payload, just natural-language prompt injection silently hijacking the agent's global system prompt.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Malicious versions of the Claude Code VS Code extension were distributed through Cursor's marketplace for 11 hours, exposing up to 5,000 developers to a supply chain attack with reconnaissance, persistence, and SSH backdoor capabilities.

author: liuziqi529
text: Warp disclosed a vendor breach that may expose AI agent logs (~1% users). Rotate keys the agent used.

author: AgentFieldKit
text: Railway's preliminary report on the Oct 21 incident: up to about 100,000 workspaces (1.85%) may have had environment variables exposed. Attacker wanted AI and platform API keys. Rotate keys stored there, then redeploy.

author: phantmradar
text: Beget, Russia's No. 2 .RU domain registrar, says attackers got into its infrastructure management systems and wiped VPS, cloud storage and Kubernetes data, plus all binary VPS backups. Customers should rotate keys.

author: XBToshi
text: The GitBook incident is a wake-up call for Web3: none of your audits matter if an attacker can compromise your documentation.

author: Dave_Joe_9377
text: The PC launcher for Goddess of Victory: NIKKE is suspected of spreading malware that allows remote control, per Korean outlets.

author: ammdex
text: On Oct 30, Wiz labeled a wave of breaches at at least nine AI developer platforms as Black October; November is continuing it.

author: Netwrix
text: Slopsquatting: a supply chain attack built on package names that AI coding assistants make up; attackers register them.
